CommunityApplications.Profile:
**WebDataStudio** — a database studio that runs in your browser.
PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, DuckDB, ClickHouse, MongoDB and Redis in one container: schema explorer, SQL editor with completion and history, a visual query builder, result charts, ER diagrams drawn from the foreign keys, schema editing, a column-by-column comparison between two connections, saved and scheduled queries with file export, and an MCP endpoint for AI agents.
Connections are added in the studio or handed to it as WDS_CONN_<NAME> variables. Set the admin user and password: without both, the studio has no login screen at all.
Support: https://github.com/fgilde/WebDataStudio/issues
